text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (—It will soon be Valentine's Day.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(At my old school, I used to exchange lots 
of chocolates with my friends. Valentine's 
Day is always so much fun.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Still... this year is a little different. 
I feel nervous. Because...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Ooh~! Flower-chan, you're giving 
chocolates to your Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You've done so much for me, so I 
wanted to give you something to show my 
appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, I don't really know what kind of 
chocolates would be good to give to an 
adult...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because Mayano-san is so grown-up. Please 
let me ask for your advice!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So “grown-up”...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, leave it to Maya☆ Just sit back and 
relax like you're on a jumbo jet! I call 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-Pounding♪ Adult Valentine's 
Mission"! Let's get started☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(And so began the bustling days leading up 
to Valentine's Day.)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mission One! "Researching What Adults 
Like"!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"According to this magazine... adults seem 
to prefer a bitter, rich flavor!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've seen Trainer drinking coffee before. 
I'll give the bittersweet flavor a try 
too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mission Two! "The Mature Mind Games 
Challenge"!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Adults don't just express their feelings 
straight out! They said on a drama that 
making someone wonder "which is it?" is 
what's alluring!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mind games, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, surprises sound fun too, don't 
they? The other day, Trainer was startled 
by a colleague when passing by in the 
hallway, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Even while saying, 'That surprised me!' 
she was beaming with a huge smile. It was 
such a wonderful smile.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Maybe try making the inside of the box two 
tiers...? I'll think about it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mission Three! "Setting the Mood on a 
Mature Date"!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The mood when you give it to them is super 
important too! So, I looked up popular 
dating spots for adults online and sent 
them to you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Thank you so much! Every single 
place is so wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, this restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you wanna go there? I heard the night 
view is super pretty☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... um. Near here, there's a park where 
the canola blossoms are really pretty.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I won't say it out loud, but... I think 
you really like pretty things, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking that I'd love to take them 
there someday...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wait, sorry for bringing up restaurants! 
Um, this place has a really nice 
atmosphere, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...I've thought this for a while now, 
Flower-chan, but you really keep a close 
eye on your Trainer, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Do you really think so?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I'm always wondering if there's anything 
I can do to help, so maybe that's why...?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Maya might've just figured it out.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Flower-chan! Just forget all 
about the mission!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Why not? Even though Mayano-san put 
so much thought into it...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You see, Maya might've messed up. I was so 
happy to be called an adult... that I only 
looked at the surface.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"You know, Flower-chan definitely 'gets 
it' way more than Maya does."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So, handing it over in your own 
Flower-like way is the best plan... And 
Trainer would be the happiest with that 
too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...If you say so, Mayano-san, then I'm 
sure that's true. So, I'll try handing it 
over in my own way."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, Mayano-san. There's one thing... 
that I think is different.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mayano-san isn't wrong at all! Because 
Mayano-san's mission was so mature and 
thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, it was so much fun. Thank you so 
very much!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe, thanks☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Good luck, Flower-chan! Maya will be 
cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (And—)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, Happy... Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Please accept this as a token of my 
gratitude for always helping me!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I managed to give the chocolates to 
Trainer in my own special way♪)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, Mayano-san. I will carry out the 
mission properly!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Why? Maya made a mistake, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm not wrong!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was really at a loss. Trying to figure 
out how to make a mature Trainer like you 
happy...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Mayano-san brainstorming with 
me, we came up with so many wonderful 
ideas!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So... Mission Number Four! 'Give it in a 
way true to myself'!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll carry every single one out properly. 
Because Trainer-san will surely be happy 
with the me who "grew" alongside 
Mayano-san...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Flower-chan...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Mission complete! Flower-chan, you're 
already a wonderful grown-up. Do your 
best!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you very much!
And—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, Happy Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, you've eaten so much of my 
cooking, Trainer. But...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I really think today's chocolate, which I 
came up with together with my friends, is 
the most delicious one yet!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's a slightly grown-up flavor, tailored 
in my own way. Please, savor every 
bite...♪
